purpose: Seal manifest for the unseen-package fixture directory. The freeze checks in tests/contract-model/architecture-proposal-node-identity.test.ts and tests/contract-model/phase-3f1-1-forensic-machinery.test.ts assert that the directory contains EXACTLY these entries: no new package directory (no new-package inspection / contamination) and no silent removal. This replaces the stale hardcoded prefix allowlist those tests carried (conmed-/dsgr-/fwrg-/lsb-/phase-*), which predated later sanctioned packages and admitted any new entry that happened to start with a known prefix. Adding or removing a package now requires a deliberate, reviewable edit to this manifest in the same commit. Presence is what this seal pins; content integrity of the ground-truth packages is pinned by their own integrity manifests (e.g. phase-3f1-1-integrity-manifest).
